annotations.title: How to hire in the UAE without a local company

tools.description: How hiring in the UAE works through Moha, an Employer of Record, for a company with no UAE entity: when it fits, the information needed about the hire and the company, the employee's documents, the steps, the timeline and the prices. No account needed.

annotations.title: Price a hire in the UAE

tools.description: Monthly and upfront cost of employing one person in the UAE through Moha, an Employer of Record: salary split, employer costs, government fees, insurance, our fee and VAT, plus how long the visa takes. No account needed.

children.description: Children moving with them on family visas.

annotations.title: Prepare a hire for the person to confirm

tools.description: Prepares one hire in the UAE without an account. Returns the quote and a link: the person opens it, checks the details and creates their Moha account. Moha checks the company before the hire goes ahead. Nothing is charged or sent to the employee before that.

children.description: Children moving with them on family visas.

company_name.description: The hiring company’s name, to prefill the account.

emirate.description: Where they will work. Defaults to Dubai.

employee_email.description: The employee’s personal email, if known.

inside_uae.description: True if the person is already in the UAE. Defaults to false (coming from abroad).

insurance.description: Health insurance plan. Defaults to standard.

job_title.description: Their job title. It goes on the work permit, so use the real one.

monthly_salary_aed.description: Total monthly package in AED: basic salary plus allowances. Example: 20000.

nationality.description: The employee’s nationality, as a country name. Example: India.

spouse.description: True if a spouse will move with them on a family visa.

start_date.description: Wanted start date, YYYY-MM-DD. At least two weeks from today; earlier dates are moved to the earliest possible.

your_email.description: Their work email, on their company’s domain, to prefill the account. Personal, forwarding and throwaway addresses are refused.

your_name.description: The name of the person you are helping, to prefill the account.
